```yaml
name: Comment Artifacts on PR

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Test and Build"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  comment-artifacts:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: >-
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v11
        with:
          workflow: test-build.yml
          workflow_conclusion: success
          commit: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          name: grml-live-iso
          path: artifacts

      - name: Find PR number
        id: pr
        run: |
          # Get the PR number from the workflow run event
          # The workflow_run event contains the head_sha which we can use to find the PR
          PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr list --search "sha:${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}" --json number --jq '.[0].number')
          if [ -z "$PR_NUMBER" ]; then
            echo "No PR found for commit ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Generate artifact list
        id: artifact-list
        run: |
          # Generate markdown list of artifacts
          ARTIFACT_LIST=""
          for file in artifacts/*; do
            if [ -f "$file" ]; then
              filename=$(basename "$file")
              ARTIFACT_LIST="${ARTIFACT_LIST}- [${filename}](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}/artifacts)\n"
            fi
          done
          # Write to a file to avoid injection issues with multiline outputs
          echo -e "$ARTIFACT_LIST" > artifact_list.md

      - name: Create artifact comment
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          pr-number: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.pr_number }}
          comment-tag: artifact-links
          mode: upsert
          file-path: artifact_list.md
          message: |
            ## 📦 Build Artifacts
            
            The following ISO artifacts were generated for this PR:
            
            ${{ steps.artifact-list.outputs.artifact_list }}
            
            > Artifacts are available for 90 days after the workflow run.
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
